case.units: Each series states the units of its measurement; the fraction is dimensionless.

columns.name: fraction
columns.why: The largest measured error over its independently derived bound among the series' cases; each writer asserts every case below one. Last-bit errors vary across machines, so it is recorded for the figure and not compared.
